chapter: Circus shows and learning to voice
title: Setting the circus band up as an orchestra
summary: He explains trombones in early jazz, his use of bass drum and trap drummers, French horns for piano sound and clarinets for reeds, and the band's size.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Hadn't heard of -- I mean, in those days they didn't even have three trombones in band, did they?
No, they had -- it was four in that band, though, that I was playing in, see.
Yeah. But in those sort of -- in the early jazz groups, the trombones were sort of voiced with the
They was sort of voiced with the trumpets. When the trumpets got a little bit too swift, the trombones would (unintelligible) or something else to do, tailgate, they called it.
Yes, yes.

But in this case here, the musicians were terrific musicians in those bands. They were hand picked. Because they could play any of those overtures, anything, you know. So the way I set the band up as an orchestra, we didn't have no trap drums. I'd get the bass drummer just to play his bass drums, sit there and beat the bass drum.
Yeah.
And I'd get the trap drummer, one of the trap drummers, to come and play the trap. So two men was doing just what one guy does today. One would play the after beat --
Yes, I see. Yes.

And for the piano, I would get me two or three French horns, voice two or three part harmony for them, and just let them play the after beat just like a piano would play, they'd use a lot of that. So that would give that piano sound. And we didn't have any saxophone players in the band. But later on had clarinets, I'd take the clarinets and do reed work.
Now, when you were doing this, these would be guys from the white band as well?
If we'd run short, I'd get a couple of white guys. It didn't make any difference, they all wanted --
Well, how big was the black band?
The black band was about 14 pieces.
Well, where would you get four trombones from, out of that?
Well, see, I was doubling.
Yeah.
And then I'd get a couple of guys from the white band.
Yes, I see.
Because they had -- no, that band was bigger than that, because they had three trombone players.
Well, there you go.
Yes, they did.
Yeah.
Four trumpets -- no, they must have had a much bigger band than that.
